title: Chetz versus match
description: Firestore document `matches/{matchId}` written only by Cloud Functions (createMatch / joinMatch / findMatch / startMatch / reportProgress / finishMatch / leaveMatch / cancelMatch / expireMatches). Readable by its two players. Both players solve the same puzzle; only progress percentages are shared, never the grid.

letterCells.description: Letter cells of the puzzle; null when the server could not resolve the puzzle size.

solutionHash.description: `PuzzleCodec.solutionHash` the finish must match; null when unknown (then hashes are not checked).

inviteCode.description: Six upper-case alphanumerics for invite matches; null for random matches.

players.description: Keyed by uid; one entry while waiting, two from `ready` on.

startedAt.description: Server time the race started (status running).

firstFinishAt.description: Set when the first player finishes; the opponent then has 15 minutes.

finishedAt.description: Set when the match is closed (finished or cancelled).

expiresAt.description: When the scheduled `expireMatches` job closes the match if nothing happens: 30 min waiting, 10 min ready, 60 min running, 15 min after the first finish.

ms.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch (server clock).

progress.description: Share of letter cells filled, as reported by the player's client (≥ 1 s apart).

rewards.description: What the settlement credited (coins through `users/{uid}/ledger/match_{matchId}_{uid}`, XP and season points on the user document).

capped.description: True when the per-day reward cap swallowed this reward.
